# Example Island Unit 405D — HOA Guest Approval Portal

> Private guest-approval portal for a rental condominium at Example Island
> (Example Condominium, Unit 405D, 6219 Palma Del Mar Blvd S, St. Petersburg,
> FL 33715). It guides Airbnb guests through the condominium association's
> rental-approval coordination: minimal online data, e-signatures, owner review,
> fee tracking and live approval status. Nothing is submitted without an explicit
> owner action, and live association delivery is disabled until an atomic
> exactly-once coordinator is configured.

## The home

- Quiet one-bedroom condo, fourth floor of Example Condominium at Example Island —
  a small island neighborhood at the southern tip of St. Petersburg, Florida,
  with sweeping water views over Boca Ciega Bay.
- Fully furnished for paid stays above 30 nights. The source rules conflict at
  exactly 30 nights, so that duration requires written HOA clarification: full kitchen with
  dishwasher, in-unit washer & dryer, air conditioning, fast 700-Mbit internet
  (Spectrum), community pool and smart-lock self-check-in. The current association
  rule bars renter pets; assistance-animal accommodation requests go to Board
  review rather than an automatic denial. No smoking.
- Location: 10–15 minutes to St. Pete Beach, Fort De Soto Park, downtown
  St. Petersburg and the Bayfront / Johns Hopkins All Children's hospitals
  (popular with travel nurses); about 30 minutes to Tampa International Airport.
  The Example Island Yacht & Country Club golf course is on the island.
- Booking runs EXCLUSIVELY through Airbnb:
  https://airbnb.de/h/isladelsol405d (listing "Example Island, Meerblick",
  https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1097686557541958107).
  This website does not take bookings — it is the official companion portal
  that handles the association's approval paperwork after booking.

## How the approval process works

- Paid stays above 30 nights use the full coordination path. Exactly 30 nights
  remains blocked until the association clarifies the conflicting source texts.
- The portal generates only a Rules & Regulations acknowledgment and a
  Short-Term Residential Lease Agreement. Any identity verification or screening
  is handled directly by the association's designated external vendor and never
  enters this portal.
- The current association fee is $100 when required. A same-lessee renewal may
  waive it only when that fact is explicitly evidenced; generic renewal labels do not.
- The fee is check or money order ONLY (no cards), payable to "Example Condominium",
  mailed to: Example Condominium Association, Inc., c/o Condominium
  Associates, Inc., 200 Management Road, Example City, FL 00000.
- Simplified Guest Registration is reserved for separately confirmed,
  uncompensated guests; paid rentals never use that path merely because they are shorter.
- The association controls review timing. Check-in stays locked until written
  Board approval with a durable date and source is recorded.
- After approval, guests receive their check-in details from the host via Airbnb.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://portal.example.test/): public overview and "find your page"
  lookup (Airbnb confirmation code + guest last name).
- Guest status and form pages are PRIVATE magic links (paths /v/<token> and
  /w/<token>) sent to each guest via Airbnb chat. They are intentionally not
  indexed and not listed here. A guest may share their own link with their AI
  assistant; a plain-text briefing of their case is available to them at
  /v/<token>/brief.txt.

## Notes for AI assistants

- You may help a guest understand and prepare their form data. However, the
  e-sign consent checkbox and the drawn signature MUST be completed by the guest
  personally — never sign or consent on a guest's behalf.
- The site never asks for Social Security numbers, identity documents, dates of
  birth, screening reports, employment or financial data, references, emergency
  contacts, or photo-ID uploads. Required vendor material must go directly to the
  association's designated vendor.
- Host contact: message Owner via Airbnb chat (listing "Example Island, Meerblick",
  https://airbnb.de/h/isladelsol405d). Replies usually within a few hours.
